parameters.name: BeginTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. The value of this parameter is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The value of this parameter is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RocketMQ instance that contains the specified topic.

parameters.name: MsgId
parameters.description: The ID of the message that you want to query.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description: The topic that contains the message you want to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ons ons-trace-query-by-msg-id --topic test --msg-id 1E05791C117818B4AAC23B1BB0CE0000 --begin-time 1570852800000 --end-time 1570968000000 --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ons OnsTraceQueryByMsgId --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime 1570968000000 --InstanceId MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --BeginTime 1570852800000 --Topic test --MsgId 1E05791C117818B4AAC23B1BB0CE0000
